pr.title: Prevent custody fault tests from writing bytecode
pr.body:
The custody OSError tests launch a child Python interpreter without `-B`. When a parent suite uses `-B` without an inherited bytecode environment flag, that child can write `tools/__pycache__/periodic_pilot_custody.*.pyc` into the checkout. Main #809 independently sets `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1` in navigation; this change also makes the test's own child safe in other invocation contexts.

Add `-B` to the child and an isolated behavioral regression. The regression clears both `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE` and `PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX`, so a cache redirected outside the inspected source tree cannot conceal the defect. The two existing OSError tests remain intact.

An instrumented diagnostic on the #809 tested tree observed the cache file before and after the same `SOURCE_MISMATCH` setup error, but its workflow context differed and the original failing run did not record its path. Its original artifact and the independent source reproduction are retained at [evidence commit 8c3d8a55](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/blob/8c3d8a55a947138e23c741f42654bb1c137c4080/cbz/evidence/main809-navigation-20261110/observer/observer-verified-summary.json). The first regression admitted a flag-removal mutant with an inherited cache prefix; that failure and the correction are retained at [4e048126](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/blob/4e048126c619824a3c54d5a4d6ac375752d5a970/cbz/evidence/main809-navigation-20261110/observer/main812-prefix-adverse-summary.json).

Validation:
- Local CPython 3.12.14 and 3.13.5: three focused tests per mode; the prefix-aware flag-removal mutant fails as expected.
- Hosted CPython 3.11.18 [run 42799022192](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/actions/runs/42799022192): three candidate tests and the flag-removal mutation in each parent mode with and without a cache prefix. Original artifact `13753569871` and independently checked logs are retained at [165e7506](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/blob/165e7506ac71aa6923d99d56544ae9a3fb72035c/cbz/evidence/main809-navigation-20261110/observer/main812-v2-focused-summary.json). That run tested the same test blob `95628e4b1cf895ca905fef32b46228ac2d76f6d8` before reconciliation with the new #809 head.
- The earlier candidate's [navigation run 42797711397](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/actions/runs/42797711397) succeeded with 2,785 normal tests and 23 skips; it is bound to the earlier head and is not full G5. Original artifact and logs are retained at [cfd4141b](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/blob/cfd4141b994c0b07ca2754c40c562abdf29ffbb9/cbz/evidence/main809-navigation-20261110/observer/main812-v1-navigation-summary.json).

Fresh checks on the reconciled head are pending. No full G5, CBZ-0 or scientific conclusion is claimed. The draft targets #809 and has not changed its ref.

root_pr.title: feat: add source-bound Stage 1 unittest qualification helper
root_pr.body:
Adds a source-bound unittest helper for actual discovery inventories, original-suite complement execution and bounded inert evidence joins. The existing architecture producer, timing recorder and archive reader remain byte-exact.

Navigation evidence now stays under `RUNNER_TEMP/navigation-evidence`. The job also declares `PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: '1'` so unchanged Python children inherit bytecode suppression. A closed native probe of one unchanged periodic-custody method observed an ignored source cache file followed by the helper's strict `SOURCE_MISMATCH`; changing only that declaration kept both the original method and a fresh helper import successful. The original full-navigation dirty filenames were not recorded, so the probe is retained as a confirmed mechanism rather than a historical filename census. All actual failure/probe streams and native context remain under the narrowly owned Stage 1 evidence directories.

Current head `9ad2edf96a836532daea3dafb904793ecbf46552` has tree `111ec264e36b15a03bb3c5150247003198fc1609` and ordered parents `[02973f39…, 90436128…]`. Full nontruncated comparison confirms 43 additions and five reviewed modifications versus fresh Main, preserving all other 6,178 leaves. Both temporary diagnostic workflows are absent from this PR. [Exact source/tree proof](https://api.github.com/repos/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/git/blobs/090f5000bf15ee6a49d6bdbf9d3463a88cad32c5).

Fresh automatic validation is running: [ten targeted contracts in normal/optimized modes](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/actions/runs/42798123421) and [full original navigation controls](https://github.com/d6g8k5htny-coder/main/actions/runs/42798123331). Qualification requires the actual original streams, all ten navigation parent bodies, 33 consumer methods, later history/graph controls, native status/context and seven file-printer results. Prior runs stay bound to their original sources.

The helper, frozen ten-parent tests, targeted workflow, five protected sources and original producer methods remain exact. The consumer changes preserve the original job digest after only closed output/printer/environment normalization. Synthetic TEST archives and API fixtures establish inert consistency only. Existing conditional skips receive no G5 credit; prepared full-suite qualification, authenticated qualification acquisition, owner/data/custody, G5, CBZ and science remain unawarded. No manual dispatch/rerun was used. Ready and merge await actual fresh results and all protected integration guards.
